organization_and_why.name: Feed My Fam Nfp
organization_and_why.why: vehicle cold storage, takes up to 3 pallets, collects within 4h
organization_and_why.profile_excerpt: Mobile distribution serving neighborhoods without a fixed pantry. Reefer van with pallet capacity, but no static warehouse. Route flexibility is our strength - a same-day diversion is usually possible.

whose_neighborhood.tract: Nearest census tract: 11% of residents below the poverty line, 3% of households without a vehicle, 8% on food or cash assistance (ACS; recipient location is ZIP-level, so this is the area, not the exact block).

outreach_message:
Hello Feed My Fam Nfp team,

A grocer in Chicago has ten crates of spinach. It is still good but has to move soon. From what we have on file you have the storage for it. The food needs to leave by about 6 hours from now, which leaves you roughly 2 hours of slack to collect. You are set up to collect it yourselves.

Can you take it? If you can, tell us the time you can collect and a phone number for pickup. If not, a quick no helps us move to the next place.

Thank you,
[Coordinator name]
